# ZOE — account brief

## Who

ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as ZOE at joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe))
- joinzoe/zoe-app last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app))
- The App Store listing has 22,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- 8 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- The org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), 121 commits, top contributor to joinzoe/zoe-app; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app; profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3))

## Why now

The app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)) and the repo was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)). It runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 121 commits in joinzoe/zoe-app, which carries an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)). The repo also has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). At that cadence, where does the handoff between those workflows and your EAS builds cost you the most time?
